corrections.text: The article quotes VentureBeat as saying Alibaba reports cutting Work360 task costs "from $4.43 to $1.67, representing approximately 62% savings." VentureBeat's actual wording is "reducing the average cost of a task in its internal Work360 evaluation from $4.43 to $1.67, approximately 62%" — it does not contain the words "representing" or "savings." The figures themselves ($4.43, $1.67, 62%) are accurate.

The article quotes VentureBeat as describing token consumption dropping "roughly 24% at the Xhigh reasoning setting and 35% at High." VentureBeat's actual wording uses "approximately," not "roughly": "token consumption falls approximately 24% at the Xhigh reasoning setting and 35% at High on Work360." The figures themselves (24%, 35%) are accurate.
